newsitem.title: USA: Braun's March same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Braun's March same-store sales up.

text.p: Braun's Fashions Corp said Wednesday same-store sales for the four weeks ended March 29 rose 35 percent.

It said total sales in March were $7.0 million, up 16 percent from last year. It said this is despite the company having closed 51 unprofitable stores last year related to its successful Chapter 11 reorganization action.
The company attributed its strong performance to ongoing customer acceptance of its updated merchandise offerings. Braun's said the early Easter this year had a positive impact on sales as well.
